title: VTG Playboy Magazine December 1964 Christmas issue - Loose Cover And Back Page
descriptionText:
See pics for damage. 

The product is a vintage Playboy Magazine from December 1964, featuring a Christmas issue with a loose cover and back page. This edition includes illustrations and covers topics such as photography, art, and modeling. Published by American Media Inc, the magazine appeals to collectors interested in men's lifestyle, history, and illustrations, making it a unique piece for anyone looking to revisit the cultural landscape of the 1960s with a focus on the holiday season.
